description: This file contains test cases for verifying the behavior of soft expectations in Playwright test framework, including compilation checks, runtime behavior, error reporting, and test info error collection.

methods.name: soft expects should compile
methods.description: Verifies that soft expect calls compile without errors.

methods.name: soft expects should work
methods.description: Checks that soft expects produce the expected output and error code during runtime.

methods.name: should report a mixture of soft and non-soft errors
methods.description: Tests error reporting behavior when mixing soft and hard expects.

methods.name: testInfo should contain all soft expect errors
methods.description: Ensures that testInfo.errors correctly aggregates soft expect errors.
